claims.summary: The Japan Foundation describes group 2 verbs as vowel-stem verbs and illustrates the change from -る with 見る and 食べる.

locators.description: Elementary 1, Lesson 1, PDF p. 18 (printed L1-18), group table: group 2 stems end in vowels and dictionary -ru changes, with 見る→見ます and 食べる→食べます.
